note: Wheels unpacked into the common renderer image by _fetch_wheels.py, never by pip (same shape as providers/fetcher/wheel-pin.json). Filled from PyPI's JSON API by a person (the supervisor); `build` and the image's own fetch refuse while any field is empty. The opencv_python_headless size and sha256 are the ones the P9-a spec recorded on 2026-11-26; its filename and url, and every numpy field (the newest 2.x release at least 14 days old with cp311 manylinux2014 wheels for both architectures), are still to be read.
